title: Contact Hub plugin API: shared primitives
description: Primitives referenced by every other schema. See docs/plugin-api.md section 8.

Id.description: An opaque identifier: non-empty UTF-8, at most 256 bytes. Never assume numeric form or ordering.

AccountId.description: The core-assigned account id. Opaque to plugins.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC date-time. Producers emit exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ; consumers accept any RFC 3339 date-time.

Cursor.description: An opaque paging cursor chosen by the plugin.

Path.description: An absolute filesystem path. Paths emitted by a plugin must lie inside its cache_dir or state_dir.

Ext.description: Platform-specific extension data, keyed by plugin id. Stored verbatim, never interpreted by the core.

Empty.description: An empty result. Unknown fields are ignored for forward compatibility.
